programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E01 - India Part 1
programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E07 - Potato
programme.desc: Lauren explores the culinary possibilities of the humble potato. She demonstrates how to make perfect crispy potato wedges, a hearty potato and vegetable curry, and homemade gnocchi recipe that is hard to beat.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E08 Tofu
programme.desc: Discover the delicious and nutritious world of tofu with Lauren as she experiments with various textures and flavors, pushing the soybean to its limits to create amazing dishes like Scramble tofu and the sweet-spicy delight of Tahu Gejrot.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E117 - Irish Stew, Licorice, Mozzarella, Khachapuri
programme.desc: The best sommelier in the world. Buffalo Mozzarella from Italy: how the Original is Made. The secret of licorice. Ireland’s National Dish: Irish Stew. Cantuccini – crunchy and delicious. Khachapuri – a Georgian specialty.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E118 - Cinnamon Buns, Cevapcici, Żurek, Fries
programme.desc: Balkan street food: Iconic Cevapcici rolls. Su Filindeu Noodles. Cinnamon Buns - Sweden’s favorite pastry. Belgian fries - Crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside. A Polish specialty: Żurek sour rye flour soup.

programme.title: Andiamo! UPTOWN S01 E21 - Royal Caribbean Adventure Of The Seas Part 2
programme.desc: In this continuation episode, Donna basks in the ships spa, takes a Yoga class, visits the engine room, displays some ice skating skills on- board "Adventure of the Seas" as well as exploring Antigua and Barbados.

programme.title: Andiamo! UPTOWN S01 E23 - Singapore
programme.desc: Donna visits one of the greatest jewels of Asia. She will experience various cultures, unique cuisines, acrobat training, exploring the fine art of tea as well as receiving foot therapy from fish!!!

programme.title: Andiamo! UPTOWN S01 E01 - Jungfrau & Interlaken, Switzerland
programme.desc: Donna will experience Canyoning, Jetboating, Snow Sledding, a unique Zip-Line adventure and so much more in one of Switzerland's most idyllic regions.

programme.title: The RVers S01 E11 - Disabled RVers, Solar Power
programme.desc: Jim & Mica are an inspiring couple who teach us that nothing can keep you from enjoying your life.

programme.title: The RVers S01 E12 - Conquering Alaska, RV Insurance
programme.desc: Tom & Cait take us through an Alaskan expedition as they live out the lifelong dream of many RVers.

programme.title: The RVers S01 E13 - Non-RVer Transition, Overnighting
programme.desc: Most people whose work relates to the RV industry don’t actually RV, such as Sean.

programme.title: Epic Trails S01 E01 - Banff And Lake Louise
programme.desc: Follow Eric Hanson on his adventures heli-hiking, caving and backpacking.

programme.title: Epic Trails S01 E02 - Australia's Northern Territory
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads down under to explore the Larapinta Trail and Kakadu National Park.

programme.title: Chasing The Sun S02 E03 - Bali
programme.desc: Island of the Gods. With Bali’s ecological majesty as our backdrop, we find people working hard to make a difference in their community and coming together to save the planet.

programme.title: Rock The Park S06 E17 - Gold Butte National Monument
programme.desc: Colton and Jack are at Gold Butte National Monument in Nevada for an overlanding journey that takes them into the desert backcountry, where they find ancient petroglyphs, a massive sink hole, colorful rock formations and a gold-mining ghost town.

programme.title: Rock The Park S06 E18 - Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary
programme.desc: Colton and Jack are in Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary to learn about the massive decline of the area's coral reef and to see how local divers and marine researchers are defending and even replanting this important underwater ecosystem.

programme.title: Art & The City S01 E01 - Chicago NB
programme.desc: "David Keeps explores Chicago’s rich artistic legacy, from historic skyscrapers and world class museums to edgy galleries and street-level creativity. Revealing how the city’s architecture, public art, and diverse neighborhoods shape its vibrant cultural identity ."

programme.title: Art & The City S01 E02 - Paris NB
programme.desc: David Keeps explores Paris’s artistic soul, from haute couture and macarons to Impressionist masterpieces, underground studios, and absinthe rituals uncovering timeless creativity in grand museums, hidden galleries, and the poetic pulse of the City of Light.

programme.title: American Canvas S01 E01 - San Francisco
programme.desc: Dave Holmes uncovers San Francisco’s artistic soul, from Alcatraz’s political art and Chinatown’s culinary secrets to vertical dance in Oakland, beat poetry in North Beach, and botanical wonders in Golden Gate Park.

programme.title: Euromaxx Architecture E63 - From Red Square to Glass Houses
programme.desc: Waterfront Luxury: A Houseboat in Berlin Europe's Famous Landmarks: Red Square Living in a Glass House in Zurich Living With Nature in Iceland An Ark on the Slopes of the Carpathians Tiny Houses Making it Big

programme.title: Andiamo! UPTOWN S01 E14 - Montreal, Canada - JGO
programme.desc: Donna visits Montreal and will explore some of the great Quebecois cultural and epicurean wonders of this amazing metropolitan city. In addition she will try jet boating as well as learn more about why Montreal the unofficial "world headquarters" for the circus arts.

programme.title: Descending S01 E04 - The Emerald Sea
programme.desc: Scott brings Ellis and the Descending team home to Canada for some cold-water diving off Vancouver Island. Scott and Ellis make friends with some questionable creatures and then pilot a jet at 80ft below the surface. Above the water, the team is put to work preparing a ship for scuttling.

programme.title: Scottish Islands With Ben Fogle S01 E03 - Northern Outer Hebrides
programme.desc: Ben Fogle returns to Scotland’s sacred Outer Hebrides, exploring Harris and Lewis in a personal journey shaped by spirituality, nature, and community. From ancient rituals to modern faiths, he uncovers transformative island experiences and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Into The Rising Sun E01 - Fugu
programme.desc: Global traveller, Scott Wilson, returns to Japan to tour around by motorcycle, and experience the country's rich cultural and cuisine offerings found off the typical tourist trail.

programme.title: Americas Treasures Musical Cities E02 - New Orleans
programme.desc: The episode highlights New Orleans as a world-class "Creative City of Music" and the birthplace of jazz.

programme.title: Americas Treasures Musical Cities E03 - Miami
programme.desc: We highlight Miami as a vibrant, tropical hub for Latin American music, specifically focusing on its salsa scene. The series explores how Miami’s unique cultural landscape, heavily influenced by Cuban and other Latin American traditions, shapes its distinct musical identity.

programme.title: Americas Treasures Musical Cities E04 - Chicago, Illinois
programme.desc: We explore Chicago as a legendary music hub. The episode likely showcases the city's rich musical heritage, which includes its influential blues, jazz, and house music scenes, highlighting key venues and artists that defined the city's sound.

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation S01 E03 - Las Vegas Navada NB
programme.desc: An adventure-focused episode highlighting the family taking in the vast landscapes, hiking, or exploring the, natural wonder of the National Park.

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation S01 E04 - Washington D.C. NB
programme.desc: The family explores the nation's capital, visiting iconic monuments, museums, and historical sites, offering an educational yet fun, experience.

programme.title: Lucky In Love S01 E01 - Alana and Josh in Fort Worth NB
programme.desc: Alana and her boyfriend, Josh, visit Fort Worth, Texas, letting fate guide their itinerary. The coin toss leads to unexpected and exciting experiences in the city.

programme.title: The Da Vinci List Chefs E01
programme.desc: Meet the modern culinary artists who have transformed their fields.

programme.title: DW Tasty Taipei - Food, Fusion and Fun
programme.desc: From street food at the Raohe Night Market to gourmet cuisine: eating in the Taiwanese capital Taipei offers a wide variety of experiences. The city’s food reflects the many different cultures that have influenced Taiwan over the centuries.

programme.title: Travel Man S11 E01 - 48 Hours In Vilnius
programme.desc: Joe Lycett is back with the definitive guide to 48 hours away in some of the most exciting short to medium haul destinations on Earth. In this first episode, comic Sarah Millican joins Joe for a fast and funny exploration of the Lithuanian capital, Vilnius.

programme.title: Travel Man S11 E02 - 48 Hours In Dublin
programme.desc: Joe Lycett presents another definitive guide to a fast and funny 48 hours away in Dublin, with comedian, Mawaan Rizwan, for two days of statues, swimming and swigging stout.

programme.title: Travel Man S11 E03 - 48 Hours In Salzburg
programme.desc: This week Joe Lycett heads to the Austro-German border with Roisin Conaty, as they spend 48 hours in the fairy-tale city of Salzburg.

programme.title: Travel Man S11 E04 - 48 Hours In Marseille
programme.desc: Comedian, writer and actor Asim Chaudhry joins Joe Lycett to spend le weekend in Marseille, France’s oldest and sunniest city.

programme.title: Race Across The World S02 E09 - Extraordinary Journey, Ordinary People Endure NB
programme.desc: Over 54 days, five pairs of ordinary Brits took on the challenge of a lifetime and attempted to travel, at ground level, the entire length of Latin America: from Mexico City to Ushuaia, Argentina, the most southerly city in the world – with no planes, no credit cards and no smartphones in sight. They came across extreme weather, states of emergency, evacuations, challenging budgets as well as life-changing encounters, incredible acts of generosity and dramatic landscapes. Most of all, they had to survive each other.

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E13 - European Islands
programme.desc: Discover the green island of Ireland, find out why the inhabitants of La Gomera like to whistle, enjoy the view from the highest rock in Europe on Madeira and take a donkey taxi on the small Greek island of Hydra.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.desc: Forget wool and alpaca fiber; upcycled socks and grocery bags are where it's at! Tune in to find out how to turn any tubular (and cuttable) material into knittable yarn.

programme.title: Multitasking for Knitters: Two-at-a-Time Socks
programme.desc: Beat single sock syndrome with a little multitasking! The girls go over how to knit two socks at once so you'll never end up with solo socks again.

Candie Cooper celebrates diversity with whimsical cone kids. She also crafts one-of-a-kind wooden kokeshi dolls. Jenny uses age-old symbols to monoprint a family crest to frame or use for banners.

programme.title: Lettering
programme.desc: Today we take a very personal approach using our names and monograms. Our first projects are monogram ornaments made from air dry clay. Then make initial letter necklaces for you and your friends. Today's art journal technique is lettering -- learn some tips for simple calligraphy. Finally make an initial bulletin board covered with initials and doodle art.

programme.title: Spotlight on Bracelets
programme.desc: Author and instructor Melissa Grakowsky-Shippee creates stunning beaded components using two-hole tile beads and teaches her technique for a flawless herringbone stitch. Katie discusses the various types of memory wire as she makes a glass bead bracelet that's fun to wear.

programme.title: Leather and Chainmaille Jewelry
programme.desc: Author Laura Poplin combines the ancient art of leatherwork and chainmaille to make beautiful contemporary jewelry. Learn to make colorful dyed and painted leather rectangles and finish them into jewelry using classic leatherworking techniques. Laura shows how to connect leather pieces with Byzantine chainmaile weave to make a cuff style bracelet. Katie demonstrates a quick and easy cup chain bracelet.

programme.title: Casual
programme.desc: Scrapbooking can get very regimented – with the right way to use a product or the correct way to lay out a page. Today we're encouraging a more casual approach – one that fits your life style and design aesthetics. Take a casual approach to your scrapbooking with two "hello" themed pages, scrapbook sketches from Kelly Purkey, and five ways to use lattice designs from Sara Naumann.

programme.title: Mediums
programme.desc: Not all artists use brushes, and paint is not their only medium of choice. On today's episode, we begin with a lesson inspired by Camille Pissarro as we paint using a palette knife instead of a brush. Then meet Dina Wakley for a graffiti inspired, modern street art design. We finish up with Cheryl Boglioli and a 3D sculpture using an interesting medium to create a female form reminiscent of modernism.

programme.title: Curved Log Cabin Quilt
programme.desc: Angela ponders on her new year's resolutions as she builds a curved log cabin quilt using ombré fabric.

programme.title: Tutorials on the Classics
programme.desc: Our experts show some of their insider tips for garment construction. First is sewing expert Linda Lee with a lesson on sewing with knits and pucker free hems. Angela Wolf is next with a Little Black Dress segment and how to deal with zippers that are just too long for your garment. Finally, Cindy Hogan demonstrates the way the professionals cut machine embroidered designs for applique.

programme.title: Stringing Projects Using Double-drilled Beads
programme.desc: Author and designer Kristal Wick has some fabulous stringing projects featuring double drilled beads. She shows how to design coordinating necklace and bracelet using double drilled beads. Kristal also has a segment discussing metal clay. Katie shows how to store and organize seed beads.

programme.title: It's All in the Details
programme.desc: It's the little things that count – from the tiniest embellishment to the handwritten letter - it's all in the details today on Scrapbook Soup. Create simple cut out graphic cards, learn about packing tape photo transfer with Sara Naumann, and backgrounds almost as pretty as the picture in a prom layout with Stacey Caron– today on Scrapbook Soup.

programme.title: National Sewing Circle presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Learn to sew, step-by-step with National Sewing Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: Vettai
programme.desc: "They are part of a special task force assembled to tackle cases pertaining to the Indian community and Indian immigrants. The unit is not widely publicized and their work is kept under wraps. Spearheaded by Chief Dayanidhi, the team consists of three teams and an assigned criminologist. Together they try to tackle cold blooded murders, kidnaps and sexual crimes. But as their professional and personal lives collide, the team is headed towards a perilous outcome. Lives will be lost and bonds will be broken. The pledge that they made to uphold justice and peace in the country that they love will be put to the test. How will they survive? Where does it all lead to? Who is the villain and who is the hero?"

programme.title: Night Of The Living Dead
programme.desc: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the Northeast of the United States.

programme.title: Purple Death From Outer Space
programme.desc: Flash Gordon, Dale Arden and Dr. Zarkov return to the planet Mongo for an antidote to the Purple Death, which wreaking destruction on Earth. However, Ming the Merciless has other plans for them.

programme.title: All American Co-Ed
programme.desc: All-girl school Mar Brynn tries to get more pupils and publicity by making fun of the Quincton college. For revenge, the boys there sent Bob Sheppard to Mar Brynn, dressed as a girl, to give them a slight scandal.

programme.title: Identity Unknown
programme.desc: An amnesiac soldier, the only survivor of a group of four unidentified soldiers - victims of a bomb raid - visits each man's address with the hope of restoring his memory and identity.

programme.title: A Boy And His Dog
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a boy who can communicate with his dog telepathically is targeted by a mysterious committee.

programme.title: The Navy Way
programme.desc: The experiences of a disparate group of young men as they make their way through Navy boot camp.

programme.title: Prisoner In The Middle
programme.desc: Palestinian guerrillas, Israeli commandos and an American colonel fight to keep a nuclear warhead mistakenly dropped in the Jordanian desert by a U.S. Air Force nuclear bomber.

programme.title: Nosferatu (1922) Remaster Colorized
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence and real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: They Raid By Night
programme.desc: The British Commandos send Bob Owen to Norway to prepare for a raid. His mission also includes freeing General Heden who is being held by the Nazis.

programme.title: Commandos
programme.desc: During World War II, an Italian-American commando outfit disguised as an Italian Army unit is parachuted behind Axis lines in North Africa.

programme.title: The Last Chance
programme.desc: Escaping a Nazi prison train in war-torn Italy, an American and a British soldier set out for the Swiss border and find themselves leading a multi-national party of refugees for the Italian underground.

programme.title: The Torch
programme.desc: A revolutionary and his band take over a small Mexican town. The townspeople begin to take sides over whether to fight him, join forces with him or just try to get along with him.

programme.title: A Trip to the Moon by George Mlis 1902 B&W Silent
programme.desc: A group of astronomers go on an expedition to the Moon.

programme.title: Nosferatu (1922) Remaster Colorized
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence and real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: Mclintock! 1963
programme.desc: John Wayne leads the charge in McLintock!, a rip-roaring Western comedy brimming with action, romance, and frontier spirit. As wealthy cattle baron George Washington McLintock tries to keep the peace between feuding homesteaders, rowdy cowhands, and local Native tribes, he also faces his toughest battle yet—his fiery estranged wife (Maureen O’Hara), who’s just returned to town. Filled with slapstick brawls, lively banter, and heartwarming humor, McLintock! delivers classic Western entertainment with larger-than-life charm.

programme.title: The Fighting Renegade
programme.desc: A government agent falsely accused of murdering a professor takes the identity of "The Puma", a Mexican vigilante leader, to hide his real identity and find the actual killers.

programme.title: China 9 Liberty 37
programme.desc: The railroad hires a condemned killer to murder an uncooperative rancher but the assassin fails to deliver, prompting the railroad men to go after him instead.

programme.title: Annie Oakley - Annie Calls Her Shots
The Gabby Hayes Show - Watchmaker
programme.desc: Dramatizing the lives of historical figures, such as the naval commander, the lawman and professional gambler, and the outlaw Belle, tall tales and Western scenes

programme.title: Tombstone Canyon 1932
programme.desc: In Tombstone Canyon, cowboy hero Ken Maynard rides into a lawless valley shrouded in mystery. A masked outlaw known only as ‘The Phantom’ terrorizes the land, leaving fear in his wake. With danger around every corner and secrets buried deep in the canyon’s shadows, Maynard must uncover the truth and bring justice to a town on the brink.

programme.title: Billy the Kid Trapped (1942) Colorized
programme.desc: In Billy the Kid Trapped, Buster Crabbe returns as the notorious outlaw, hunted across the frontier with his pals Fuzzy (Al St. John) and Jeff (Malcolm ‘Bud’ McTaggart). When the trio is framed for crimes they didn’t commit, they must outwit the law, battle ruthless schemers, and fight to clear their names. Packed with fast-paced action, blazing gunfights, and lively camaraderie, this classic Western proves that even a wanted man can ride for justice.

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First 1971
programme.desc: In Kill Django… Kill First, George Eastman stars as a deadly drifter who rides into a corrupt frontier town ruled by greed and gunmen. When the outlaws push too far, Django answers with blazing six-guns and relentless vengeance. Packed with gritty shootouts, treachery, and Spaghetti Western style, this action-filled tale proves that in the West, the first to draw is the last to survive.

programme.title: Frontier Town 1938
programme.desc: In Frontier Town, Tex Ritter rides into a lawless settlement torn apart by scheming outlaws and ruthless ambition. With his trusty six-shooter and a song in his heart, Tex takes a stand to protect the innocent and bring justice to the frontier. Blending hard-riding action, stirring melodies, and Ritter’s trademark charm, this Western adventure captures the spirit of the untamed West.

programme.title: Death Rides The Range 1939
programme.desc: In Death Rides the Range, a band of ruthless spies schemes to steal America’s uranium supply, but they didn’t count on the Three Mesquiteers! Leaping into action, the daring trio battles danger on the open frontier, matching fists, six-guns, and wits against a deadly enemy. Packed with intrigue, hard-riding action, and patriotic spirit, this adventure delivers Western thrills with a timely twist.

programme.title: Terror at Black Falls (1962)
programme.desc: In Terror at Black Falls, a quiet frontier town is shaken when a bitter land feud erupts into violence. With murder, betrayal, and greed tearing the community apart, one man must stand against the terror sweeping the valley. Gritty, fast-paced, and filled with danger, this hard-hitting Western lives up to its name.

programme.title: Rock River Renegades
programme.desc: Recently elected Marshal Luke Graham falls under suspicion when he's unable to discover the local band of rustlers, which are really led by Jim Dawson, who is also trying to steal Grace Ross, daughter of the local newspaper editor.

programme.title: Apocalypse Joe 1970
programme.desc: In Apocalypse Joe, Anthony Steffen stars as a wandering gunslinger who inherits land in a lawless frontier town. When ruthless killers move in to claim it for themselves, Joe answers with blazing six-guns, deadly precision, and a flair for theatrical showdowns. Bursting with Spaghetti Western style—complete with brutal action, sweeping vistas, and a haunting score—this cult favorite turns vengeance into a deadly performance on the stage of the Wild West.

programme.title: The Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Cowboy infiltrates an outlaw gang to expose their rackets, but after he's ordered to kidnap a young girl, the gang finds out who he really is.

programme.title: Code Of The Cactus 1939
programme.desc: In Code of the Cactus, cowboy hero Tim McCoy rides into action when a greedy gang plots to seize control of the stagecoach line. With fast-draw courage and sharp wits, he takes on the outlaws to protect the frontier’s lifeline. Filled with hard-riding action, shootouts, and frontier justice, this thrilling Western proves the West was won by men who lived by a code as tough as the cactus itself.

programme.title: Law of Vengeance
programme.desc: 'Law and Order' may not have been in its absolute prime yet, understandable though as it was still early days at this point. The pre-Briscoe seasons and episodes were still good though, with some fine episodes and not really any that one would call a misfire

programme.title: The Crooked Trail
programme.desc: Jim Blake rescues criminal Hare Talton and Good Samaritan Estaban Solano from dehydration and death and tries to rehabilitate Harve by taking him in as partner in his gold strike.

programme.title: Dead Aim
programme.desc: A traveling gravedigger during an (unspecified) war adopts a orphan he finds alone in the desert. After the war with the orphan grown and business slow, the orphan begins to generate business himself by shooting people

programme.title: The Trusted Outlaw
programme.desc: Dan Ward, reformed and last member of an outlaw family, meets Molly Clark in a rocky draw near town. Ted Wells, a henchman for Dan's enemy Jim Swain, attempts to shoot Dan but is outdrawn and killed by the latter. Molly disappears and Dan learns that she and Wells had ridden there together.

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: The first film adaptation of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's classic novel about a land where prehistoric creatures still roam.

programme.title: esther and the king 1960-1
programme.desc: Two decades before she would gain fame and some fortune as Alexis Carrington on Dynasty (1981), Dame Joan Collins starred as Esther in this melodramatic, routine Biblical story. The setting is Persia in the fourth century B.C., as Esther comes to the attention of the recently widowed King Ahasuerus

programme.title: Midnight Cop (1988 color)
programme.desc: The nude body of a beautiful young dancer is found sprawled in a sand pit dead from a stab wound and an overdose. The investigation leads to a labyrinth of obsession, danger and death

programme.title: The Fat Spy
programme.desc: Off the coast of Florida, a nearly-deserted island is rumored to have the fountain of youth. A boatload of teenage kids are headed there for a scavenger hunt.

programme.title: A Boy And His Dog
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a boy who can communicate with his dog telepathically is targeted by a mysterious committee

programme.title: It Takes A Thief
programme.desc: A gang leader dumps her criminal boyfriend when he is convicted of robbery, but he recovers the stolen loot once he's released. In retaliation, the gang kidnaps his son and demands the money as ransom.

programme.title: The Lucifer Complex (1978 color)
programme.desc: An intelligence agent discovers a Nazi plot to revive the Third Reich by using clones.

programme.title: Mitchell (1975 color)

programme.title: Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde Starring John Barrymore
programme.desc: Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself.

programme.title: Great Guy Starring James Cagney
programme.desc: The adventures of an investigator (Cagney) for the Bureau of Weights and Measures.

programme.title: cp_071_his_girl_friday
programme.desc: When a newspaper editor's ace reporter ex-wife is about to quit her job and remarry, he buys himself time to win her back by promising her an exclusive interview with a death row convict.

programme.title: Bluebeard Starring John Carradine
programme.desc: In Paris, an artist hires portrait models, and after he finishes their portraits, he strangles them.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson must protect a Swiss inventor of an advanced bomb sight from falling into German hands.

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: An investigator from the War Crimes Commission travels to Connecticut to find an infamous Nazi.

programme.title: Spirits of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: Chang Chen-Wai, a martial arts expert who runs a jade-importing business, follows his missing brother to Thailand and learns he has been murdered. Chang vows revenge

programme.title: Shadow Ninja
programme.desc: He works both sides of the law. He gets teamed up with a young cop who he is told to take under his wing. They end up working together well and the young cop's martial arts skills are very useful

programme.title: Kung Fu Arts
programme.desc: The emperor's right hand man frames the princess's fiancé, King Chi, who goes into hiding for ten years, vowing revenge. Meanwhile, the princess is married to King Chi's monkey.

programme.title: Ninja Empire
programme.desc: The Ninja Empire has been run by an evil master and one member decides to leave the empire. The ex-Ninja wants a Hong Kong detective to track down the new leader and end his reign of terror.

programme.title: Weapons of Death
programme.desc: A police commissioner tries to bring a gangster to justice as the kingpin's out-of-control crimes set even his own underworld allies against him.

programme.title: Ninja Death

programme.title: 37 Plots of Kung Fu

programme.title: Cigar City Unrolled
programme.desc: A beloved local institution steeped in tradition. Known for its hand-rolled cigars and authentic Cuban heritage, La Faraona offers a unique glimpse into the craft of cigar making. The episode dives into the shop's history, its role in the Ybor community.

programme.title: Cigar City Unrolled
programme.desc: Join us for an in-depth look at what it takes to turn tobacco leaves into a premium hand-rolled cigar at the El Rojo factory.

programme.title: The Cigar Guys Podcast
programme.desc: Alex and Jon discuss the subjective nature of cigar flavor notes. They emphasize that tasting notes are based on personal memory and experience, and there is no right or wrong answer. They also talk about how marketing and packaging can influence a person's perception of a cigar's flavor. The hosts share anecdotes about unusual flavors they've encountered, like "gun taste" and "peanut butter and jelly," and argue that what matters most is consistency and a positive smoking experience.

programme.title: Cigar Essentials
programme.desc: In this episode of Cigar Essentials, hosts Howard G. and Rachel G. unbox and review five cigar accessories. They demonstrate a variety of tools, including a cedar-lined travel case kit , a digital humidometer , a rose-gold torch with an integrated cutter , and a set of protective mouthpieces. The show concludes with a heavy cast-iron monkey ashtray that vents smoke through its nostrils, with the hosts highlighting the unexpected affordability of all the products.

programme.title: Burn Rate
programme.desc: Join seasoned tobacco authorities Bryan and Chris as they put the highly anticipated Cohiba Riviera under the microscope. Expect a detailed breakdown of its construction, flavor profile, and overall smoking experience.

programme.title: Cigar TV Original Documentaries

programme.title: Privada Cigar Club

programme.title: Creekside Cigar Co.
programme.desc: In this episode of the Creekside Podcast, hosts Dave and Scott explore the differences between natural and "cooked" Mexican San Andrés cigar wrappers. They explain that the cooking process, known as vapor rosado, uses steam to darken the leaf into a uniform, dark chocolate brown hue while enhancing sweetness and depth in the final blend.

programme.title: Creekside Cigar Co.
programme.desc: In this instructional overview, the cigar manufacturing process is explained through the roles of the buncher, who assembles fillers and binders by weight, and the roller, who applies the outer wrapper.

programme.title: Burn Rate
programme.desc: Bryan and Chris, the discerning palates behind Burn Rate, turn their attention to the Grandeur Cremo cigar. They'll meticulously analyze its blend, construction, and smoking characteristics, offering their experienced insights into this intriguing offering.

programme.title: Creature in the Dark
programme.desc: After strange creatures arrive, a husband waiting for the return of his wife, must adjust to being sole caretaker of his young daughter, while dealing with what is in his basement...

programme.title: Baby Doll
programme.desc: A group of student in vacation find themselves in a house where strange rituals were performed. The sudden finding of a doll bring the group on a downward spiral...

programme.title: Blue Hour
programme.desc: Olivia Brandreth was nine years old when her father disappeared. Twenty five years later, she has returned to her childhood home to finally get closure in an unrelenting attempt to set the record straight...

programme.title: The Elevator (ITN)
programme.desc: A reporter discovers all is not as it seems at an infamous hotel...

programme.title: Horror High 2020 Tyler J. Case
programme.desc: A monster lurks around a high school in the hypnotized town of Willow Hills and picks off tardy students one by one. Now it is up to an unlikely group of teens to put an end to the terror that has plagued many...

programme.title: Lake Terror
programme.desc: Remington has escaped the evil cabin but now the evil continues to follow him, wreaking havoc wherever he goes. Meanwhile, Chloe and Revel look for a missing sister that went to the evil cabin in the previous installment. The two meet Vincent, a failing TV host, to help psychically contact the missing sister. That's when a gunshot rings out in the night and the three meet Remington. Now they all must battle for their lives against the evil that pursues Remington to once and for all lock the evil away for good...

programme.title: Jack and Jill: The Hills of Hell
programme.desc: After searching for her missing daughter, a lady and her search party discover the legend behind the murderous pair of Jack and Jill...

programme.title: Village of the Vampire
programme.desc: Rebecca is searching for her sister, a young journalist who went missing while investigating a series of unfortunate events. The trail leads her to Timere, a remote place far from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, where amidst the tight lipped silence of the town's inhabitants there's an ever growing fear of dark forces at work and no-one dares to leave their home at night. Here Rebecca meets an extravagant writer, the church warden of the town and above all Caleb, a charming, rich and elegant man whose dark gaze hides a chilling secret. It's in this town, where time appears to move between the shadows and danger lurks around every corner that Rebecca learns of the terrible truth and the battle between good and evil begins...

programme.title: Clown Motel
programme.desc: Clown Motel follows a group of ghost hunters, coming from an old ghost town and a bachelorette party, returning home from Las Vegas. When the groups meet up, by mistake, they're left to discover if the motel is really abandoned and haunted by the souls, of the clowns, that once lived there...

programme.title: Demon Baby
programme.desc: A young couple looking to rekindle a damaged relationship retreat to the remote Scottish Highlands. They are haunted by their past, their surroundings and each other.

programme.title: The Last Nosferatu
programme.desc: Ethan has been single for several months and decides to meet people via the Internet. One night, he dates “Black Pearl” whom he literally falls in love with, but she disappears, so he decides to go looking for her. One evening, Black Pearl resurfaces and seems to be hiding a mysterious secret that will lead him to a tragic fate...

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: After his daughter goes missing, a wealthy contractor hires a group of investigative journalists to probe into an abandoned town with hope of uncovering clues about her disappearance...

programme.title: Early Grave
programme.desc: On the eve of their ten year high school reunion, six people are summoned to the isolated country estate of one of their former friends, now a famous horror writer. Once there, separated by guilt, yet bound together by a terrible secret, seven adults try to reconnect with each other, and take stock of their lives. Outside, the storm clouds gather. Rain, lightning and wind isolate the house by washing out the road and knocking down the power lines. And then, they begin to be brutally murdered one by one. Someone is out there in the wind and the rain, someone who has waited for ten years to wreak a terrible vengeance on this group. Seven friends find themselves in a struggle to survive and outwit a diabolical killer who is savagely committed to sending them all to an EARLY GRAVE...

programme.title: Kecksburg
programme.desc: A reporter investigates a mysterious crash and uncovers more than an object, but a massive government conspiracy. Inspired by the real life events of December 9, 1965 and one of America's most mysterious UFO incidents...

programme.title: El Bosque del Diablo
programme.desc: Rachel y su equipo de cineastas viajan a Transilvania, Rumania, para documentar los fenómenos paranormales en el bosque de Hoia-Baciu...

programme.title: Mi Sangriento Cumpleaños
programme.desc: Tras un terrible trauma en su cumpleaños, Emma decide no volver a celebrarlo. Pero al cumplir 21, una amiga rompe el ritual con una fiesta sorpresa, sin percatarse del despertar de los horrores que durante años han estado acechando en la oscuridad...

programme.title: La Feria del Diablo
programme.desc: Protagonizada por Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson y John Charles Dickson. Las estrellas de dos series de televisión paranormales, rivales y enfrentadas, convergen en un parque de atracciones embrujado y abandonado que termina siendo el epicentro del infierno. Ahora están todos atrapados en una guerra sin cuartel contra el mal puro...

programme.title: Naufragio
programme.desc: Mientras transportaba un paquete importante, una joven sufre un accidente de coche en medio de la nada, dejándola atrapada debajo del coche. Poco a poco, se da cuenta de que no solo unos hombres muy malvados la persiguen para recuperar el objeto que transporta, sino que algo muy peligroso la acecha desde las profundidades del bosque...

programme.title: El Juego del Duende
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre adinerado envía a un grupo de ladrones a buscar leyendas urbanas con la intención de abrir un museo lleno de criaturas míticas, pronto descubrirán la leyenda de un duende...

programme.title: Verano Sangriento
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero adentrándose en los lugares más inhóspitos de la isla comenzarán un viaje infernal...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Recuérdame
programme.desc: Rose despierta en una casa desconocida tras un grave accidente de coche, con pérdida de memoria y sin poder caminar. Su madre y su novio están allí para ayudarla. Rose quiere reconstruir su vida antes del accidente. No todo es lo que parece...

programme.title: La Maldición de la Sirena
programme.desc: Un joven se enamora de una joven seductora y sensual que conoce en la playa. Cuanto más se enamora de ella, más aprende los peligros de enamorarse de una sirena...

programme.title: Aldea del Vampiro
programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, una estudiante de último curso de instituto, es la estudiante perfecta, la maravillosa hija de un veterano detective de policía y todo un sueño americano. Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Isla Pitón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que buscan un árbol mágico en una selva misteriosa descubren que no están solos. Algo los observa, esperando el momento perfecto para atacar...

programme.title: El Ejecutor
programme.desc: Montana, sicario del cartel, enfrenta al Buitre para rescatar a la sobrina del capo.

programme.title: El Inicio de una Sicaria
programme.desc: Ivana busca vengar la muerte de su familia y se inicia como sicaria para enfrentar a los asesinos.

programme.title: Carrera a Muerte
programme.desc: Dos hombres criados como hermanos se enamoran de la misma mujer y su amistad se pone a prueba.

programme.title: El Charro Juarez
programme.desc: Largometraje sobre la vida y aventuras de un guerrero en la guerra cristera y el ambito militar.

programme.title: El Comandante antrax
programme.desc: El comandante Ntrax defiende la plaza del cartel contra los Kaibiles que buscan tomar el control.

programme.title: De Apellido Pesado
programme.desc: Las hermanas Carrillo expanden su negocio de narcotrafico y enfrentan a carteles rivales con fuerza.

programme.title: El 24
programme.desc: Chema, apodado El Tumbador, recibe el encargo de eliminar a Manuel por meterse con la amante de un capo.

programme.title: Caribe Sangriento
programme.desc: Un hombre obtiene superpoderes tras un enfrentamiento entre policias y traficantes.

programme.title: El Pistolero
programme.desc: Un hombre sencillo se une a un poderoso mexicano para vengar la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Brindis Mortal
programme.desc: Ramon, hijo de un narco, busca ser su mano derecha, pero decisiones impulsivas cambian su relacion.

programme.title: Catemaco Magia y Misterio
programme.desc: Una familia es atacada en Catemaco y el padre, con ayuda de un brujo, busca vengarse de los criminales.

programme.title: Asesinos Sin Ley
programme.desc: Mickey y Jenny matan a un abusador y se vuelven antiheroes virales luchando por los desamparados.

programme.title: El Gavilan Justiciero
programme.desc: La codicia y ambicion desatan una cruenta lucha que causa sufrimiento y envidia entre familias.

programme.title: Vidas Violentas
programme.desc: integrada por seis cortometrajes escritos y dirigidos por seis de los más connotados directores mexicanos, la película fue realizada y dirigida para concientizar y reducir la violencia de género, el acoso escolar en las escuelas y la violencia doméstica. Proviene de una iniciativa del gobierno en el marco de la campaña basta no violencia

programme.title: Despertar El Polvo
programme.desc: Es la historia de un hombre que ha sufrido las desgracias de vivir una vida trasgredida por la delincuencia y corrupción, el barrio de Iztapalapa es el escenario donde vaga por las calles, invisible, ignorado y solitario, sumido en su miseria. Un evento desafortunado mueve el instinto protector de Chano que intenta regresar al mundo del crimen para lograr sacar a su ahijado de la cárcel.

programme.title: De La Piel del Diablo
programme.desc: La atracción se desata entre un hombre y una mujer que se conocen en una galería de arte. Comparten gustos y aficiones, y ambos parecen ser justo lo que el otro necesita… pero lo que debería haber sido una noche de pasión, pronto se convertirá en un juego perverso, lleno de trampas y mentiras, en el que nada es lo que parece.

programme.title: El Ultimo Verano
programme.desc: Carlos es un Profesor de universidad a punto de jubilarse, pero su futuro se ve en peligro porque una de sus alumnas lo acusa de haber sido acosada. Esto es solo el inicio de la peor racha de su vida ya que Carlos descubre que su esposa lo engaña y que la vida que el creía perfecta se esfuma poco a poco de sus manos... tal vez sea el ultimo verano en la vida de Carlos

programme.title: Como El Gato y El Ratón
programme.desc: El barrio de La Estrella es uno de los más pobres de Bogotá. Allí habitan ciudadanos que han sido desplazados por la guerra y la violencia. Un día y tras años de espera, la luz eléctrica llega al barrio. La gente lo celebra y, pese a oponerse el edil, deciden usarla de manera ilegal. Todo se complicará cuando dos familias tengan un conflicto por unos cables cruzados.

programme.title: Dos Abrazos
programme.desc: Cuatro personas que se ven forzadas a defenderse ante la vida, un ensimismado chico de doce años, la cajera que tiene un encuentro con él, un airado conductor de taxi y la enajenada hija de uno de sus pasajeros, se reúnen en dos abrazos.

programme.title: El Bosque del Silencio
programme.desc: UNA MUCHACHA CONOCIO A UN HOMBRE POR INTERNET Y SE ENAMORA DE EL UN DIA DECIDIO IR A VERLO EN PERSONA, AUNQUE SU FAMILIA SE LO PROHIBIO ELLA DE CUALQUIER MANERA SE FUE PERO CUANDO LO VIO NO PODIA CREER LO QUE PASO

programme.title: Espacio Interior
programme.desc: Lázaro permanece secuestrado en un cuarto de tres metros cuadrados completamente aislado del mundo exterior. Obligado a revelar información íntima sobre sus familiares, cae en una desidia total. Al borde de la muerte, se da cuenta, esperanzado, de que su voluntad y su mente nunca podrán ser secuestrados. Es posible que jamás lo liberen, pero su gran fe y dignidad le muestran la inquebrantable naturaleza del espíritu humano.

programme.title: Error 113
programme.desc: Cuatro extraños se encuentran en el apartamento 113 invitados por Annie Annie, una aplicación de inteligencia artificial que ayuda a las personas con sus problemas cotidianos. Annie Annie les ha dicho que la aplicación es en realidad una persona real y que se van a encontrar cara a cara. Después de un tiempo, estos extraños comienzan a sentirse incómodos a medida que se dan cuenta de que Annie no va a poder hacerlo.

programme.title: El Campeón
programme.desc: LA HISTORIA DE UNA PROMESA DEL BOXEO, SU ENTRENADOR SOLO LO USA PARA BENEFICIO PROPIO. LA FAMA Y EL DINERO SOLO LE TRAE PROBLEMAS, ADEMAS QUE SUFAMILIA SE APROVECHA DE EL.

programme.title: Gritos del Monday
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de Ingeniería Ambiental realizan un trabajo en la Reserva Ecológica de los Saltos del Monday, conocido por su rica fauna y su rica historia. Para el trabajo, los alumnos deciden acampar en el lugar, en medio de la obscura noche son sorprendidos por un hecho que desencadenará a lo largo de sus días posteriores, en especial a una de las estudiantes.

programme.title: Choele
programme.desc: Todo ocurre en el pueblo de Choele Choel, provincia de Río Negro. Un niño y su padre intentan seguir juntos todo el verano, pero el chico ya decidió partir hacia otro lugar con su madre, cuando ésta llegue y le recoja. A la zona donde viven llega una chica, por la que comienzan a competir padre e hijo.

programme.title: Cuernavaca
programme.desc: El mundo de Andy cambia totalmente cuando su madre tiene un accidente. Sin nadie que lo cuide, es llevado a Cuernavaca, a la casa de su desconocida abuela paterna. Mientras su madre se debate entre la vida y la muerte, el niño se enfrentará a la frialdad de su abuela, al mundo seductor y peligroso del hijo del jardinero y a la búsqueda de su padre

programme.title: El Sonido de los Tulipanes
programme.desc: En Buenos Aires durante la crisis del 2001, Marcelo un escritor devenido en periodista, debe volver sobre los últimos pasos de su padre Tonio un consagrado intelectual de quien se encuentra profundamente distanciado cuando muere en condiciones extrañas. De la mano de Carolina la ex secretaria de su padre, Marcelo se sumerge en un mundo oscuro lleno de violencia y ambiciones de poder enfrentándose a “El Loco” Bertolini. Pero el peligro no solo lo acechará a él sino también a los suyos. ¿Podrá Marcelo encontrar los verdaderos motivos de la muerte de su padre?

programme.title: La Mujer que Hablaba con Los Muertos
programme.desc: Es un film de Terror. Cuando Elena Castaño era una niña, tenía un don: era capaz de comunicarse con los espíritus de los muertos. pero esa capacidad desapareció al crecer.

programme.title: Expediente 53 3.0
programme.desc: Un extraño ser del más allá regresa con sed de venganza para acabar con todas las personas que lo han estado atormentando por todos estos años, decidiendo poseer a Jack y darle más fuerza a Baal.

programme.title: El Cóndor En Nueva York
programme.desc: Un narcotraficante de Nueva York, llamado Damián, ha creado una nueva droga con efectos impactantes.

programme.title: Amateur
programme.desc: Martín, es un editor que trabaja en un canal de televisión cuyo dueño es el señor Battaglia.

programme.title: Catemaco: Magia y Misterio
programme.desc: Una familia normal va de vacaciones a Catemaco, Michoacan un pueblo famoso y pintoresco en Mexico. Todo marcha bien hasta que son atacados por criminales, el padre sobrevive, y con ayuda del brujo mayor del pueblo cobra venganza.

programme.title: Entre Brujas y Nahuales
programme.desc: En la ciudad de Tulancingo Hidalgo, Acatlán y San Dionicio la gente anda muy asustada, pues se rumora que están ocurriendo sucesos fuera de lo normal, tal como desaparición de niños de quienes se han encontrado cuerpos sin sangre, dicen que son las brujas, porque han visto bolas de fuego que aparecen y desaparecen, pero nadie sabe la verdad lo que esta pasando y existe mucho miedo en la población de la región.

programme.title: Night Crappie
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors, we're firing up the grill before we even hit the water! Larry is joined by a very special guest, Reggie Hayes, the passionate president and founder of the Inner City Sportsmen Club. And making a welcome return is LSO's own chef, "Shotgun" Schafer! The show kicks off with Shotgun and Reggie trading secrets over the grill as they cook up Reggie's legendary crappie recipe. Reggie shares the incredible story of his club, a grassroots effort he primarily funds himself dedicated to introducing urban youth to the joys of fishing. He talks about their community events, from fish fries to fishing clinics supported by the Wisconsin DNR, and how they welcome any and all donations to help get kids hooked on the outdoors. Then, as dusk settles, the real adventure begins. The team heads out for a night of crappie fishing done the old-school way. Hanging lanterns over the side of the boat, Reggie explains the timeless technique: the light draws in insects, the insects attract baitfish, and the baitfish ring the dinner bell for huge schools of crappies. Reggie shares his wisdom on why deep-water summer fish have the best flavor and how the glow of the lanterns can trigger an unbelievable feeding frenzy.

programme.title: Gogebic Crappies
programme.desc: This week Larry heads north to the pristine, peaceful waters of Michigan's Upper Peninsula for an incredible adventure on massive Lake Gogebic. He's joined by expert guide Justin Soffa of Just Fish Guide Service, who has the bite completely dialed in. With the lake's ecosystem on fire from recent bug hatches, the guys are targeting giant, hungry crappies. Justin shows Larry how slow-rolling plastics and paddle tails on tungsten jigs over sunken trees and deep-water cribs is the key to loading the boat with monster paper-mouths. The action is non-stop as Justin breaks down his top summer tactics, from specific gear choices to his unique and effective bobber setup that every crappie angler needs to see. Then, for a change of pace, he breaks out the ol' tried-and-true gold hammered spoon to put a few classic Gogebic walleyes in the boat. From modern plastics to classic spoons, this episode is packed with fish-catching action and tips you won't want to miss.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Papa Gets HIV
programme.desc: Tough times don’t last for long, but this seems to be lasting quite long. Papa is at his lowest, and Buchi makes sure he rubs it in and takes advantage of this situation. But is there light at the end of the tunnel for Papa, or would this be the end of him?

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Thou Shall Not Break Anything
programme.desc: Raymond broke a vase that Sege just brought to the house, thereby flouting the commandment about not breaking anything in the house. He needed money to replace it, and Papa also needed money to impress Dorothy, so they decided to enter into a baking competition.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Mama Poultry
programme.desc: In an attempt to convince her husband to rescind his decision, Tare calls his mother, her mother-in-law to report her husband’s decision. Tokunbo’s mother came with a psychiatric doctor to evaluate his mental status. A shock awaits Tare at the end of the day.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 How To Be Broke
programme.desc: Desperate times require desperate measures; hunger and brokenness made Papa remember that a beautiful and rich lady once gave him her business card. This means food for the squatters, and they are grabbing this opportunity with both hands.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Insult To Injury
programme.desc: Esiri gets into trouble with the squatters because of his clumsiness and they beat the hell out of him, he became incapacitated for too long and it was beginning to look fake. How do they expose him?? His weakness…

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Oleku
programme.desc: Papa is in the living room keeping the records of Shege's ladies. He kept a special one for himself called Portia. Portia suddenly turned herself into a housewife immediately and started giving orders to everyone. The situation became unbearable for Shege, and he must find a way to send her away. They brought an idea of fumigation, that everyone would have to leave the house for two days, an opportunity Shege used to escape her only for Portia to come back the next day with the fumigation kits.

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Buchi And Yinka
programme.desc: Buchi long long-distance girlfriend calls him to say that she was in town and mentions the name ‘Yinka’ in their conversation. Buchi becomes disturbed as to who Yinka is. Is she cheating?

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Rats
programme.desc: Things started disappearing in the apartment, and everyone is a suspect. They think there is a ghost in the house.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 No Work At Home
programme.desc: Uche’s aunt came to visit and gave them the treat on their lives but she had a hidden agenda. But nothing beats the union of a family.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Shades Of Love
programme.desc: A strange love affair between Pero and Sade ensues. He even proposed to her and Sade was ready to leave the house with him since nobody supported their love. But when something is unbelievable and too good to be true, it usually isn’t

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Things Fall Apart
programme.desc: Papa met with an old friend Femi in a bar who was planning on going to the Third Mainland Bridge to jump over the bridge because of his life issues, while Papa was also considering doing so. Shege showed up. He told him he had been looking for him. Shege brought him to the new apartment. They agreed not to take in new squatters. Papa took pictures he posted on the internet, which opened an opportunity for the new squatters. Danjuma asked them to help his sister, Aliyah, a banker, to be with them in the house then, two other people came in immediately: Voke Papa's nephew and Chinwe, his neighbor. Voke and Chinwe are social media influencers. The three of them had to come together to save their stay in the house.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Surrogate Part2
programme.desc: Uche is shattered. She lost her baby and has to deal with the aftermath of this event. She wants another one but her husband is too busy and this causes more issues between them.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Loan Shark
programme.desc: Sade needed a loan, but no one at home could lend her, so she decided to get the money on her own. A compromising text message implicates her, and trust was almost lost.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Let's Get Married
programme.desc: Danjuma reveals the real reason he proposed to pay rent and everyone becomes friends once again. Papa proposed to Dorothy and everyone waited with optimism for her reply, whilst Rachel, Sege’s girlfriend pressures him to propose to her.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Esiri The Destroyer
programme.desc: Buchi’s friend Esiri visits the house and another chapter of trouble is unleashed.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S4 Family From Another Planet
programme.desc: In the same weekend, Tare’s dramatic and spiritual auntie Aunty Dewari and Tokunbo’s talkative cousin Dewale visits and makes the house a living hell for everyone.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Welcome Miss Amanda
programme.desc: Danjuma leaves the apartment to further his education. Sege brought a friend’s sister to squat with them for her NYSC.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Rule Of Engagement
programme.desc: In a bid to get the best out of her boyfriend Papa, Dorothy gave him some life and business hacks. Unfortunately, Papa takes it too far for her liking, and their relationship enters a sinking ship. At the same time Esiri and Raymond are frustrating the life of Danjuma and he devises the perfect plan to get back to them.

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Rent
programme.desc: The squatters faced the issue of Sege always bringing different women to their apartment every now and then. They discuss how to tell him to stop, but are torn between Sege throwing them out and they keep enduring the status quo.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Greencard
programme.desc: Buchi’s prayers to travel out of Nigeria seem about to be answered when Sureboy mentioned he is a traveling agent. Buchi invested all his money into Sureboy’s agency and even agreed to a fake marriage with an American citizen to make his traveling process faster while he prepares to leave the country.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Fool At Forty
programme.desc: Papa gets into an argument with his girlfriend over marriage and this leads to his worst nightmare

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 War Of Lords
programme.desc: Justice Tunde, Uche, and Sade traveled for a vacation, and they came back to the house in disarray courtesy of Soji. Turned out Soji was trying to shoot a music video and establish his career as a music producer, but his father would not allow it nor support his career as a music producer. He goes head-on with his father to prove himself, but family always has our back.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Wedding Party
programme.desc: Sade and Soji continue to devise new schemes to ruin their father’s union with Uche. He announces their wedding plans and puts Sade in charge of the event planning.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Am Getting Jealous
programme.desc: Justice Babatunde's millionaire friend David Jones, came to visit him. He wanted to do an event, Justice Babatunde mentioned to him that his daughter, Sade, is an event planner. He took Sade out and she got the best treatment of her life. She came home and started explaining everything to her boyfriend Prince, only for the boy to be very upset. Prince became jealous till he was rude to Mr. David Jones, well, the truth came out that he was genuinely buy things for Sade without any hidden intentions.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Cold Waters
programme.desc: Sade decides to enter a serious relationship with a top music producer Nelson, but little did they know that Nelson is just an opportunist.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 It's Sureboy Again!
programme.desc: Sureboy shows up again, but with a higher confidence. He returns Sege and Raymond’s money he had scammed them of earlier and this makes it easier for them to believe his new deal. But can a leopard change its skin?

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Fried Kidneys
programme.desc: When the pill sampling did not work, Buchi decides to sell one of his kidneys for money, he would have but for Papa's timely intervention.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Homecation
programme.desc: Their son Obafemi, who is already used to yearly vacation he did not know was sponsored by the bank, his father’s former place of work started throwing a tantrum because his parents told him they would not be traveling this year. To cheer him up, they decided to bring vacation home.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Welcome Miss Amanda
programme.desc: Danjuma leaves the apartment to further his education. Sege brought a friend’s sister to squat with them for her NYSC.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S4 The Bridge
programme.desc: After losing the investment deal and facing the loss of their house, Tokunbo becomes dejected and shuts himself out from the world, and will not come out to see his family. Tare runs again to his mother to help her reach him. In the midst of this, Tare takes a huge leap regarding her government job.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Law And Order
programme.desc: Buchi’s mother came to visit them, and her lifestyle is totally different from the Squatterz lifestyle. They struggle to endure her visit, but there is only so much they can take, and they decide to give her a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Peace was slowly coming into the house as Uche and the children started to develop an understanding. But Uche's past has come to haunt her, and this can terminate her marriage.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Buchi And Yinka Part2
programme.desc: Buchi realizes he has a son and he decides to be responsible. He moves out of the squatter's apartment to find greener pastures and take care of his son and baby mama. But how far did he go?

programme.title: Squatterz S5 Thou Shall Not Pay Rent
programme.desc: Danjuma tells Sege he will pay rent, and Sege agrees to it, but this would mean throwing Papa and Raymond out. To be fair, Sege gives Papa 7days to raise the rent or leave the house. Dorothy feels uncomfortable about all that is happening, but Danjuma gives her assurance.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Friend From Hell
programme.desc: An old friend of Tare came to visit promising to leave the same day but a day turns to two and brings too many chaos to the house

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Mr And Mrs
programme.desc: Sotonye got an ambassadorial deal and was told to bring an investment of 7million naira to be a shareholder. She went to Garba to help her, but he had a condition: She must give him what he has always wanted, Marriage. She unwillingly agreed, but nobody wins in the end.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 7
programme.desc: In this new episode of Sail-Ho we are visiting Dugi Otok, the longest and biggest island of the Zadar archipelago. It is also the 2nd most indented island in all of the Adriatic Sea, with gorgeous beaches and beautiful nature we believe is worth exploring completely. Come join us in this new adventure!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 8
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! We're in Rab, the island known by many as the island of love and happiness since Roman times. It has more than 30 sandy beaches, 2500 hours of sunshine and a mouthwatering gastronomy. Come join us and find out why this place is considered a happy place by so many!

programme.title: Skagerrak
programme.desc: SKAGERRAK follows the preparation and mental development of the Danish professional stand up paddle athlete Casper Steinfath in his attempt to be the first person in the world to paddle from Denmark to Norway.In his journey, brotherhood and friendship come to play an essential part making a dream and project like the crossing of an entire ocean come true. SKAGERRAK will take you behind the scenes of mainstream media and portrays the Northern and secluded region of Denmark called Thy, where Casper grew up.A region, where a pioneer spirit and desire for independence prevails despite adversity and isolation. SKAGERRAK is an inspirational story that touches upon the dreams, aspirations, and desires that live inside all of us. A film about the courage to reach for the horizon.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, we are in the TwinTip open Worlds in Hangloose beach, Italy where Florian Gruber has defended his title for the 3rd time! Then, we are set to join the Kite World Series in China’s Weifang and Pingtan where the fastest foilers are ready to set new records in kite foiling. We finish our journey at the final of the series that took place in Cagliari, Italy where Maxim Nocher has been crowned Champion of the series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we will focus on the action around the 2019 Kite Foil World Series, which is composed by four non-discard events. This means that all the event scores will be counted. The series began in Gizzeria, Italy and will head to China’s Pingtan and Weifang in September for two successive, action packed events before concluding in Cagliari, Italy. With the latter being the place where the male and female of 2019 Kite Foil World Champions will be crowned.

programme.title: New York - Vendée Transatlantic Race
programme.desc: This single-handed yacht race will cross the Northern Atlantic through two symbolic cities: New York and Sables d’Olonne. The departure from the Big Apple represents a cosmopolitan crossroad of influences, as well as the cradle of the IMOCA Class, while the arrival in the Sables d’Olonne means landing in the Old Continent after days or weeks of harsh conditions.After crossing a risky and challenging course straight through the middle of the “iceberg alley”, the skippers will arrive in the heart of the Vendée Globe considered as the “Everest of the Sea”. The Transatlantic race is the final event of the IMOCA Globe Series and it allows racers to build their hard racing miles. It represents a further opportunity to reinforce its image as a marine region, thus it is an awaited event for all those sailors thinking about embarking on the Vendée Globe.Follow their journey from New York to Sables d’Olonne in New York – Vendée Transatlantic Race. Available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 4
programme.desc: The race course of Riva del Garda is well-known for its dramatic cliff face and 1000m mountain peaks on its west shore as well as the typically strong wind and flat-water conditions. It’s the 5th time Lake Garda has hosted the foiling catamarans as part of the GC32 Racing Tour. The heavyweight battle at the top of the leaderboard was between the Adam Minoprio-skippered Oman Air and Ernesto Bertarelli’s Alinghi, helmed this week by Swiss ace Arnaud Psarofaghis. These two teams sit on the top of the leaderboard on equal points after 3 of the 5 events this season. Heading into the Riva del Garda event, holding third were the Austrian Olympic Tornado double gold medallists Roman Hagara and Hans-Peter Steinacher and their Red Bull Sailing Team. In this episode, we dive into the action of the GC32 Racing Tour in Riva.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez - Meetings at St Tropez
programme.desc: Les Voiles de St Tropez Regatta is the closing event of the summer season in St Tropez and the Riviera. For the 2017 edition of this event, over 300 of the most amazing sailing yachts from all over the world - classic and modern - plus 3500 crew, unite in St Tropez for a week of racing and festivities. Join us on Nautical Channel for the latest action at Les Voiles de Saint Tropez!

programme.title: P1 USA Offshore - Episode 1 - Cocoa Beach
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP Spain - Ski
Sail-Ho - Episode 7
programme.desc: In this new episode of Sail-Ho we are visiting Dugi Otok, the longest and biggest island of the Zadar archipelago. It is also the 2nd most indented island in all of the Adriatic Sea, with gorgeous beaches and beautiful nature we believe is worth exploring completely. Come join us in this new adventure!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 8
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! We're in Rab, the island known by many as the island of love and happiness since Roman times. It has more than 30 sandy beaches, 2500 hours of sunshine and a mouthwatering gastronomy. Come join us and find out why this place is considered a happy place by so many!

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep4
Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: The glamorous city of Cannes hosts the luxury Yachting Festival par excellence for the 40th time this year and a new Luxury Gallery has been opened in the Palais de Festivals to celebrate this landmark anniversary. Breathe in the boat show’s opulence and learn about the latest trends in the yachting world!

programme.title: Skagerrak
programme.desc: SKAGERRAK follows the preparation and mental development of the Danish professional stand up paddle athlete Casper Steinfath in his attempt to be the first person in the world to paddle from Denmark to Norway.In his journey, brotherhood and friendship come to play an essential part making a dream and project like the crossing of an entire ocean come true. SKAGERRAK will take you behind the scenes of mainstream media and portrays the Northern and secluded region of Denmark called Thy, where Casper grew up.A region, where a pioneer spirit and desire for independence prevails despite adversity and isolation. SKAGERRAK is an inspirational story that touches upon the dreams, aspirations, and desires that live inside all of us. A film about the courage to reach for the horizon.

programme.title: Semaine Du Golfe Du Morbihan
programme.desc: The Semaine du Golfe Du Morbihan is an essential event for all classic sailing lovers. The Gulf Week is a maritime even set on the beautiful Morbihan Gulf, in Brittany, a French destination known for its gorgeous landscape. Expending on 35000 hectares, it is worth is reputation as the little sea. For one week, the Gulf will be letting more than 1000 ships rip through its waters. Rowing boats, lightships, classic sailing ships... almost 6000 sailors will take part in this year's edition. This joyful week has been organised in order to meet and share new experiences, so let's enduge in the best moments, most impressive boats and latest news of the 7th edition of the Semaine du Golfe Du Morbihan!

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 4
programme.desc: The race course of Riva del Garda is well-known for its dramatic cliff face and 1000m mountain peaks on its west shore as well as the typically strong wind and flat-water conditions. It’s the 5th time Lake Garda has hosted the foiling catamarans as part of the GC32 Racing Tour. The heavyweight battle at the top of the leaderboard was between the Adam Minoprio-skippered Oman Air and Ernesto Bertarelli’s Alinghi, helmed this week by Swiss ace Arnaud Psarofaghis. These two teams sit on the top of the leaderboard on equal points after 3 of the 5 events this season. Heading into the Riva del Garda event, holding third were the Austrian Olympic Tornado double gold medallists Roman Hagara and Hans-Peter Steinacher and their Red Bull Sailing Team. In this episode, we dive into the action of the GC32 Racing Tour in Riva.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez - Meetings at St Tropez
programme.desc: Les Voiles de St Tropez Regatta is the closing event of the summer season in St Tropez and the Riviera. For the 2017 edition of this event, over 300 of the most amazing sailing yachts from all over the world - classic and modern - plus 3500 crew, unite in St Tropez for a week of racing and festivities. Join us on Nautical Channel for the latest action at Les Voiles de Saint Tropez!

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, we are in the TwinTip open Worlds in Hangloose beach, Italy where Florian Gruber has defended his title for the 3rd time! Then, we are set to join the Kite World Series in China’s Weifang and Pingtan where the fastest foilers are ready to set new records in kite foiling. We finish our journey at the final of the series that took place in Cagliari, Italy where Maxim Nocher has been crowned Champion of the series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we will focus on the action around the 2019 Kite Foil World Series, which is composed by four non-discard events. This means that all the event scores will be counted. The series began in Gizzeria, Italy and will head to China’s Pingtan and Weifang in September for two successive, action packed events before concluding in Cagliari, Italy. With the latter being the place where the male and female of 2019 Kite Foil World Champions will be crowned.

programme.title: New York - Vendée Transatlantic Race
programme.desc: This single-handed yacht race will cross the Northern Atlantic through two symbolic cities: New York and Sables d’Olonne. The departure from the Big Apple represents a cosmopolitan crossroad of influences, as well as the cradle of the IMOCA Class, while the arrival in the Sables d’Olonne means landing in the Old Continent after days or weeks of harsh conditions.After crossing a risky and challenging course straight through the middle of the “iceberg alley”, the skippers will arrive in the heart of the Vendée Globe considered as the “Everest of the Sea”. The Transatlantic race is the final event of the IMOCA Globe Series and it allows racers to build their hard racing miles. It represents a further opportunity to reinforce its image as a marine region, thus it is an awaited event for all those sailors thinking about embarking on the Vendée Globe.Follow their journey from New York to Sables d’Olonne in New York – Vendée Transatlantic Race. Available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Ep3 - Great Family Adventure - Niagara Falls, Ontario
programme.desc: Pro kayakers Nick Troutman & Emily Jackson and family explore adventure-filled Niagara Falls, Canada.

programme.title: Bass By Kayak
programme.desc: Bass by Kayak follows a small expedition party formed by four adventurers crossing from the Australian mainland to Tasmania in sea kayaks. With a 300 km separation, a bare four hundred people have made the crossing of the Bass Strait in the modern era. Before then, Aboriginal Australians sailed in their canoes the shocking distance during the last ice age.This adventure makes strategic stops on the islands along the way; however, it is one of the toughest and deadliest journeys in the world. Adventure filmmaker Beau Miles narrates the expedition as the first ever feature film of the crossing via sea kayaks.The travellers will experience chafe, storms, bad cooking and an emerging mate-ship between men that barely know each other.Watch it now with Nautical Channel.
